verdict.rationale: The Agent API offers profiles, described as reusable, versioned configurations that you save and manage and select by ID. This gives some basis for versioning agent setups (the closest thing to an 'automation' here). Nothing describes reviewing changes between profile versions or rolling back to a prior version. Missing for 10: documented version history/diff review for profiles, explicit rollback to prior profile versions, workflow-level automation definitions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
